description: Change a matter: its name, client, reference, billing reference, colour, lead (who must already be a member of it) or visibility. Only the fields you pass are written. clientId attaches a client to a matter or replaces its client; members are managed separately, and the client does not decide who can see the matter. visibility does: all_members (every internal member), admins_and_assigned (owners, admins and assigned members) or assigned_only (assigned members only, led by an assigned internal member). Only the matter lead or an organization owner or admin may change the visibility or the lead. Pass expectedClientId (null when no client is assigned) to change the client only if its current assignment still matches; otherwise returns version_conflict.
